title: ICAB P1 - Financial Accounting and Reporting
summary: Advanced preparation, presentation, analysis, and interpretation of single entity and consolidated financial statements under IFRS/BFRS, including Islamic finance and public sector transition.

all.name: Full Syllabus Tracker
all.blurb: Official 2025 Syllabus chapter and topic tracker for Financial Accounting and Reporting. Track your study progress across all syllabus areas.

stages.title: Area 1: Accounting & Reporting Concepts and Ethics
stages.name: Area 1: Accounting & Reporting Concepts and Ethics
stages.description: Standard setting, Conceptual Framework, IAS 8 changes in policy/estimates, and professional ethics.

nodes.name: IFRS Conceptual Framework & IAS 8
nodes.description: Standard-setting process by IASB, FRC Bangladesh endorsement; qualitative characteristics; IAS 8 accounting policies, changes in estimates and prior period errors; ethical dilemmas in financial reporting.
topics: IASB and FRC standard-setting governance and adoption
IFRS Conceptual Framework: Recognition, measurement bases (historical cost, fair value, value in use)
IAS 8: Retrospective application of policy changes vs prospective estimates
Correction of material prior period errors
Professional ethics under IESBA Code when facing management pressure to misstate
learningOutcomes: Evaluate accounting policies under IAS 8.
Apply IFRS measurement bases.
Resolve ethical conflicts in financial reporting.
checklists: Practice disclosure notes for accounting policy changes
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 2: Single Entity Financial Statements (IFRS/BFRS)
stages.name: Area 2: Single Entity Financial Statements (IFRS/BFRS)
stages.description: Preparation of single entity statements applying IAS 16, IAS 36, IAS 38, IAS 37, IFRS 15, IFRS 16, IAS 12.

nodes.name: Non-Current Assets: IAS 16, IAS 38, IAS 36 & IAS 40
nodes.description: PPE revaluation and component depreciation (IAS 16); Intangible assets and R&D capitalization (IAS 38); Impairment testing and CGUs (IAS 36); Investment property fair value vs cost models (IAS 40); Borrowing costs (IAS 23).
topics: IAS 16 Revaluation model and revaluation surplus accounting
IAS 38 Criteria for capitalizing development expenditure vs research expense
IAS 36 Impairment indicators, Cash Generating Units (CGUs), impairment allocation
IAS 40 Investment Property: Dual-use property, transfers, and fair value model
IAS 23 Capitalization of borrowing costs on qualifying assets
learningOutcomes: Compute revaluations and impairment losses.
Account for intangible assets and investment properties.
Prepare non-current asset note disclosures.
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

nodes.name: Revenue, Leases, Provisions & Tax: IFRS 15, IFRS 16, IAS 37, IAS 12
nodes.description: IFRS 15 5-step revenue recognition; IFRS 16 Right-of-Use assets and lease liabilities; IAS 37 Provisions and contingent liabilities; IAS 12 Deferred tax temporary differences.
topics: IFRS 15 5-step model: Contract, performance obligations, transaction price, allocation, satisfaction
IFRS 16 Lessee accounting: ROU asset, lease liability, short-term lease exemptions
IAS 37 Present legal/constructive obligation, probable outflow, reliable estimate
IAS 37 Restructuring provisions, onerous contracts, contingent assets/liabilities
IAS 12 Deferred tax: Tax base vs carrying amount, taxable vs deductible temporary differences
learningOutcomes: Apply 5-step model to multi-element revenue contracts.
Account for leases under IFRS 16.
Compute deferred tax provisions and prepare reconciliation.
checklists: Complete 3 full IFRS 15 multi-element revenue calculations
Calculate deferred tax on revalued assets under IAS 12
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 3: Consolidated Financial Statements
stages.name: Area 3: Consolidated Financial Statements
stages.description: Group accounting under IFRS 10, IFRS 3, and IAS 28; subsidiaries, associates, and intra-group adjustments.

nodes.name: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position (IFRS 10 & IFRS 3)
nodes.description: Concept of control under IFRS 10; goodwill computation under IFRS 3 (proportionate vs fair value method); non-controlling interests (NCI); intra-group balances, cash-in-transit, and unrealized profit on inventory and PPE.
topics: IFRS 10 Control model: Power, exposure to variable returns, link between power and returns
Goodwill calculation: Purchase consideration, fair value of net assets, NCI valuation
Fair value adjustments to net assets at acquisition date and subsequent depreciation
Intra-group balances, cash and goods in transit reconciliation
Unrealized profit (PURP) in closing inventory and transfer of PPE between group entities
Consolidated retained earnings and non-controlling interest calculation
learningOutcomes: Calculate goodwill and NCI under IFRS 3.
Eliminate intra-group balances and unrealized profits.
Prepare consolidated statement of financial position.
checklists: Draft 3 full consolidated balance sheets with fair value adjustments
Master PURP inventory adjustment for parent vs subsidiary sales
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

nodes.name: Consolidated Profit or Loss & Associates (IAS 28)
nodes.description: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss; mid-year acquisitions; intra-group sales and dividends; NCI share of profit; Equity accounting for associates under IAS 28.
topics: Consolidated P&L preparation: Revenue, cost of sales, operating expenses line-by-line
Mid-year acquisition: Apportionment of subsidiary revenue and expenses
Elimination of intra-group sales, management fees, interest, and dividends
Allocation of profit for the year between owners of parent and NCI
IAS 28 Accounting for associates: Significant influence test (20-50%), equity method
Equity accounting adjustments: Group share of associate profit, PURP in associate sales
learningOutcomes: Prepare consolidated statement of profit or loss for mid-year acquisition.
Allocate comprehensive income to NCI.
Apply equity method for investments in associates.
checklists: Complete 2 mid-year acquisition group P&L questions
Review equity method balance sheet and income statement presentations
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 4: Financial Statement Analysis & Interpretation
stages.name: Area 4: Financial Statement Analysis & Interpretation
stages.description: Financial ratio analysis, statement of cash flows (IAS 7), and performance appraisal.

nodes.name: Cash Flows (IAS 7) & Comprehensive Ratio Analysis
nodes.description: Preparation of Statement of Cash Flows under IAS 7 (indirect method); profitability, liquidity, efficiency, and solvency ratios; limitations of ratio analysis.
topics: IAS 7 Cash Flows: Operating activities (indirect method), investing, and financing activities
Non-cash transactions, interest, dividend, and tax cash flows
Profitability ratios: ROCE, Gross margin, Net margin, Asset turnover
Liquidity & working capital ratios: Current ratio, Quick ratio, Inventory turnover days, Debtor days
Solvency and gearing: Debt-to-equity, Interest cover
Investor ratios: Earnings per share (IAS 33 basics), P/E ratio, Dividend yield
Limitations of financial statement analysis and qualitative factors
learningOutcomes: Construct IAS 7 statement of cash flows using indirect method.
Compute and interpret financial ratios across multiple periods.
Write an executive report evaluating corporate financial health.
checklists: Prepare 2 full IAS 7 cash flow statements with working capital adjustments
Write a 500-word performance critique on profitability vs liquidity
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 5: Islamic Finance & Public Sector Accounting
stages.name: Area 5: Islamic Finance & Public Sector Accounting
stages.description: AAOIFI accounting standards for Islamic financial institutions, and cash-to-accrual public sector transition.

nodes.name: AAOIFI Islamic Accounting & IPSAS Accrual Transition
nodes.description: Accounting for Islamic financial transactions under AAOIFI standards (Murabaha, Ijara, Mudaraba, Musharaka, Sukuk); transition from cash to accrual accounting in Bangladesh public sector; IPSAS standards.
topics: Principles of Islamic banking and finance: Riba prohibition, risk sharing, asset-backing
Accounting for Murabaha (cost-plus sale) and Ijara (leasing) contracts under AAOIFI
Mudaraba and Musharaka profit-and-loss sharing mechanisms and balance sheet recognition
Sukuk (Islamic bonds) structure, issuance, and financial reporting
Government financial management in Bangladesh: Move from cash basis to accrual basis
Key IPSAS standards: Fixed assets, financial liabilities, revenue from exchange transactions
learningOutcomes: Record Islamic financing transactions under AAOIFI standards.
Differentiate Murabaha and Ijara accounting treatments.
Explain challenges in transitioning public sector accounting to accruals.
checklists: Compare AAOIFI Murabaha accounting with IFRS 9 amortized cost
Summarize 4 key implementation steps of IPSAS in Bangladesh
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)
